plugins.name: horosa
plugins.description: 110 local Horosa (星阙) technique tools over MCP + the horosa-agent skill (clarify-before-call gate, export-snapshot reading). Requires the offline runtime once: `uv run --directory <plugin dir>/horosa-skill horosa-skill install` (plugin dir = ~/.claude/plugins/cache/horosa-skill/horosa/<version>) (any `runtime.not_installed` error prints this command with the real path).
